tulita.cp: pp. of tuleti. weighed; examined; compared.
tulita.p: [Tula+ta] (ti) CL=7 (1) It should be weighed the pros and cons (by weight scale, etc.,). (2) (A) It should be contemplated(by wisdom). (B) It should be distinguished. (3) (Wisdom, etc.,) that is a cause of contemplation and comparing. See - Tulitañāṇa. Tulita(ti) [tulā+i+ta] It is like the weight scale, One who is like a weight scale.

Dhāna, ṭī. 642.] A squirrel (kyoaoṅa, dhāna, sya), A Brown fish-owl Ketupa zeylonensis, A Barn owl (Abhayā, dhāna, sya), A flying squirrel, A Brown fish-owl 'this bird's face is like a cat's face' (Toṅapoka, dhāna, sya), Squirrel, A flying squirrel (dhāna, ṭī-and this-sya), A fruit Bat (or) A bat, A bat which is a kind of bird and it eats fruits. See also - Pakkhibiḷāla.
